study: BDD-OIA Round 10 corruption dose-response construct validation

blocking_findings.title: Practical endpoint threshold gate is not uniquely specified
blocking_findings.finding: The 0.01 A/R/S and 0.025 C1 thresholds are not assigned unambiguously to per-seed effects, the five-seed arithmetic mean, a bootstrap point statistic, a pointwise lower bound, a Bonferroni lower bound, or an all-seeds condition. Different conforming implementations can therefore produce different PASS/FAIL decisions.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Freeze the component formula, seed aggregation order, comparison operator, and uncertainty role. Recommended convention: retain every per-seed endpoint effect, use the arithmetic mean of the five seed effects for the primary practical gate, and report the bootstrap endpoint distribution descriptively without adding an unregistered confidence-bound threshold gate.

blocking_findings.title: The executable noise operator has an unbound transitive dependency
blocking_findings.finding: src/arsc_eval/corruption_dose_response.py imports deterministic_noise from src/arsc_eval/data.py, but data.py is absent from the frozen preflight code inventory. Binding only the caller does not freeze the actual filename hash, RNG, float32 sampling, clipping, and uint8-cast implementation.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Inline the exact noise implementation into the bound Round 10 module or add src/arsc_eval/data.py to every protocol, preflight, and reviewer hash contract. Add a pixel-exact historical level-2 bridge test; parameter equality alone is insufficient.

blocking_findings.title: Bootstrap tail quantile and edge-case semantics remain implementation-dependent
blocking_findings.finding: The protocol does not freeze the quantile interpolation method or state explicitly that the Bonferroni lower bound is calculated from each replicate's five-selected-seed family-axis mean bottleneck. Exact-zero, NaN, undefined F1, empty class, duplicate draw, and expanded-image-count conventions are also incomplete.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Freeze the pointwise and Bonferroni quantile methods, preferably numpy.quantile method='linear'; freeze the replicate statistic and every numerical edge case; and require preservation of all 12x5000 raw gate draws, seed selections, clip selections, expanded image counts, and quantile diagnostics.

blocking_findings.title: Semantic label-applicability decisions are not auditable from the reviewed material
blocking_findings.finding: The 30 contact sheets show filenames and images but not action/rationale labels. review_decision.json supplies default true decisions with no overrides, and the summarizer expands them into 2400 true values. This establishes visible scene preservation but does not establish 2400 independently inspected label-applicability judgments. The blank manifest was also overwritten in place, so the original artifact is not retained.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Bind and display each selected image's action/rationale label vector or label names, or remove the redundant label-applicability decision from the protocol. Bind the exact 1200-row key set and label sidecar, require strict JSON booleans and complete/unique/in-grid overrides, attest review of every pair when using a default-true batch decision, and preserve immutable raw and reviewed manifests with a verifiable transition.

blocking_findings.title: Preflight trusts semantic summaries and lacks claimed negative validation
blocking_findings.finding: The current preflight does not independently recompute the seeded sample, index-to-filename mapping, complete 1200-key grid, per-stratum counts, parameters, strict boolean types, or raw-to-reviewed provenance. The 67-test log consists of the prior suite plus four operator tests; tests/test_corruption_dose_response.py contains no semantic/preflight negative tests.
blocking_findings.required_repair: Turn all semantic structural checks into hard preflight assertions. Add outcome-blind negative tests for incorrect sample/grid, duplicate or out-of-grid overrides, page/hash mismatch, unbound transitive operator code, malformed practical-threshold schema, incorrect quantile method, and refusal of formal, staging, temporary, or prediction-cache artifacts. Produce a new preflight artifact and retain this STOP01 artifact.

operator_and_claim_boundaries.brightness: Global brightening only; not darkening, exposure-field variation, or natural low light.
operator_and_claim_boundaries.blur: Gaussian blur only; not motion blur or real optical defocus.
operator_and_claim_boundaries.noise: Deterministic iid Gaussian RGB noise added after JPEG decode; not real sensor noise.
operator_and_claim_boundaries.dose: A frozen pixel-operator parameter grid, not a natural-world severity scale.
operator_and_claim_boundaries.directional_gates: Falsifiable empirical model-by-dataset-by-operator hypotheses, not mathematical necessities of A/R/S/C1. A reversal, including improvement after brightening, must be reported as a gate failure without being generalized to global metric invalidity.
operator_and_claim_boundaries.future_pass_supports: Only joint metric-by-model-by-operator behavior on the frozen 4557-image BDD-OIA test population, five existing training seeds, frozen threshold and calibration, and the three prefixed synthetic grids under the preregistered source-clip and seed resampling procedure.
future_pass_does_not_support: natural corruption prevalence or natural severity scaling
other datasets, domains, architectures, training protocols, seeds, thresholds, or metrics
validity for all rationale ontology classes
a population-level 95 percent semantic-preservation guarantee from the single-reviewer 100-image audit

rereview_requirements: Preserve this memo, this machine decision, and every currently reviewed Round 10 artifact.
Create an outcome-blind protocol amendment or new version that closes all five blockers.
Do not load a model, run inference, create any nonzero-severity prediction cache, or implement a formal analyzer during the repair.
Generate a new outcome-blind preflight artifact and test log rather than overwriting the STOP01 record.
Obtain independent re-review before any formal implementation begins.
If implementation-only authorization is later granted, complete and hash-bind the full implementation and pass a separate independent preformal audit before requesting formal-run GO.

binding_notes.interpretation: The reviewed state is bound by the per-file hashes below. A later implementation-only GO must bind a committed complete preoutcome state and may not rely on the base commit alone.
